name: Execution mechanics through bounded subagents and review gates

findings.summary: State updates after every slice/review/repair and commit/push attempt were not explicit enough.
Same-slice documentation updates for behavior/API/runtime/report changes were not hard-gated before phase closure.
Runtime/training/eval/checkpoint evidence slices could be interpreted as outside accepted implementation slice review coverage.

recheck_evidence: Section 6.2 explicitly requires sub-agent work orders for every slice, no parent executor shortcut, review coverage for code/runtime/training/eval/checkpoint slices, DPO/quality review for token/quality/learning/eval/checkpoint evidence, same-slice docs before closure, repair loops for blocking/high findings, commit/push boundary before the next implementation slice, and state updates after every slice/review/repair/commit. Required rg terms, JSON/JSONL parsing, and git diff --check passed.
